## 🐳 DOCKER-READY 1-CLICK TEST WORKFLOW

**KYUNKI AAPKA N8N DOCKER MEIN RUN HO RAHA HAI:**
- Docker container ke andar se host Windows FastAPI ko reach karne ke liye URL **`http://host.docker.internal:8000`** use hota hai.
- `localhost:8000` Docker container ke andar point karta hai, isliye pehle `ECONNREFUSED` aa raha tha.

**TEST KARNE KE LIYE:**
1. Simply click the orange **'Execute workflow'** (ya **'Test step'**) button at the bottom.
2. Both items will execute against your host FastAPI (`host.docker.internal:8000`) and display full ML analysis!
